tableLines.line: SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
💔 A faction of Ashford has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Nadia.
🧳 Ashford has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
◈ THE EMBASSY — the table is set, the bundle is served, and the galaxy ate from it. The deed is done — the seat still waits on the deeds.
◈ THE TABLE — between now and the seat, the world holds its breath. The wild can still take your food — but it cannot take your people.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Theo speaks at The Hungry Road II's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Nadia of The Red Table with 4 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
📓 Codex: Nadia of The Red Table raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Nadia of The Red Table didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 800 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~600 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
🥣 Ruth of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
🧳 Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table has bound itself to The Hungry Road II. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.
Ruth waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
